title: Sell on DigitalHood Zambia | Start Your Online Store
description: Sell on DigitalHood Marketplace in Zambia. Apply as an individual or business, build your storefront and manage products, orders and customers in Seller Center.
heading: Sell on DigitalHood
tagline: Your products. Your store. More possibilities.
intro: Bring your business online with a storefront of your own, marketplace discovery and practical tools for your everyday selling. Built for sellers and shoppers in Zambia.

benefits.title: A store you can share
benefits.text: Bring your brand, organise your own categories and share your approved store’s personal DigitalHood address.

benefits.title: One seller workspace
benefits.text: Manage product photos, specifications, variations, prices, stock and orders from Seller Center.

benefits.title: Checkout, connected
benefits.text: Let buyers use DigitalHood’s managed checkout with supported card and mobile-money payment methods.

benefits.title: Real customer connections
benefits.text: Answer buyer messages, follow order issues and build your reputation through verified purchase feedback.

steps.title: Choose how you sell
steps.text: Start as an individual or business. Register or sign in with your DigitalHood account; your choice stays with you.

steps.title: Complete your application
steps.text: Add your store information and the verification details requested for your account type.

steps.title: Prepare your listings
steps.text: After seller approval, add accurate photos, specifications, prices and available stock for review.

steps.title: Start serving buyers
steps.text: Approved products can go live. Keep stock current, respond to buyers and fulfil your orders.

requirements: Accurate contact, identity and business information where requested.
Products you are entitled to sell and can fulfil in Zambia.
Clear photos, honest descriptions, correct prices and stock quantities.
A plan for delivery, customer questions and after-sales responsibilities.

faqs.question: Do I need a registered company to apply?
faqs.answer: Individual and business applications are available. Choose the account type that matches you and provide the verification information requested during your application.

faqs.question: What does it cost, and how are settlements handled?
faqs.answer: Applicable fees, commission and settlement schedules are confirmed in your seller agreement. Contact seller support for current arrangements before you start selling.

faqs.question: Will my store and products appear immediately?
faqs.answer: Seller applications and product listings must pass review and follow marketplace policies before they go live. Complete your application accurately and respond to any requests for more information.

faqs.question: Can I share my store outside the marketplace?
faqs.answer: Yes. Approved stores can share their assigned DigitalHood storefront address with customers. Accounts, messaging and checkout remain managed by DigitalHood.
